newsitem.title: USA: Sony to name new team to head SPE - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Sony to name new team to head SPE - WSJ.

text.p: Sony Corp is to announce on Tuesday a new team that will manage Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc (SPE), including a Japanese executive who would act as a liaison with Tokyo, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The newspaper quoted "people close to the company" in its Tuesday edition as saying it would name Yuki Nozoe to a senior post in SPE to act as a liaison between the studio and other parts of Sony Corp.
Nozoe, a Japanese native, is an executive vice president at Sony Corp of America.

The newspaper said Sony would also name John Calley of United Artists Pictures Inc and Sony Corp of America Executive Vice President Jeffrey Sagansky to top management positions within the company, as had been previously announced.
Calley would replace Alan Levine, who resigned last week.
